scope: Bounded recent accessible primary evidence; not systematic or comprehensive
selection: Targeted searches across fifteen evidence layers, independently verifying known seeds; prioritize decision relevance and sufficient methods/results over count. Aim 10–20 studies if eligible, with no minimum quota.
search_bound: Eight Europe PMC targeted queries, up to 40 records per query in API default ordering; primary publisher/PMC/registry/structure follow-up of selected candidates. Truncation, default-order recency bias and inaccessible sources are explicit limitations. Exact-identifier seed verification is logged separately, not a comprehensive search.
review_policy: All AI-assisted source assertions and impact inferences remain pending_review; no self-approval
boundaries: Genetic loss is not pharmacological inhibition
Contextual cancer biology is not AS therapeutic evidence
inaccessible_policy: Potentially material inaccessible studies are isolated; they do not block curation of accessible studies and are never treated as adjudicated or negative evidence.
decision_policy: Canonical baseline untouched unless evidence-triggered sufficient reassessment is justified; otherwise bounded AddendumDecisionImpact, no forced v2 or QSAR.
copyright_policy: Do not commit full articles; retain identifiers, access logs, hashes and original curated paraphrases with locators.
stop: Freeze bounded curated package, validate, update brief only if justified, publish branch; no Phase 3.10 or exhaustive refresh.
